text:
morgan: Quick UX review — I'm worried about the new compare toolbar stacking on narrow widths. Pasted a couple screenshots in thread, but TL;DR: it takes too much vertical space and pushes table rows off screen. Can we brainstorm alternatives?
sam: Agree, on mobile it eats the viewport. Maybe collapse into a single compact row with a "More filters" overflow instead of stacking? @anya @lee
anya: Love collapsing, but we risk hiding high-value filters. Proposal: keep primary filters visible, move advanced filters into a horizontal overflow panel labeled "More filters" (chevron). That keeps discoverability.
lee: +1 to primary/advanced split. Also keyboard flow issue: when tabbing into the catalog, focus jumps into the first compare row instead of the filter bar. Ideal tab order: Filters group -> Compare table -> Row actions. Need a clear focusable container for the filter bar (tabindex=0 + aria-label).
jordan: Accessibility + pinning note: current pin UI uses a star icon with color-only state. We should add an explicit aria-pressed state and visible text for screen readers, e.g. `button aria-pressed="true" aria-label="Unpin model v1.2"` or swap to `Pinned` text when active.
maria: Also a visual nit: performance badges (fast/slow) use a subtle green that fails contrast on our light catalog cards. Suggest stronger green or a 1px border. Could also show a tooltip with metrics: p95 latency and tokens/sec.
anya: Tooltips are fine for desktop but avoid hover-only reveals for touch. If we collapse rows, show a condensed metrics line under the model name for mobile.
sam: Copy question: should we use "Pin version" or "Lock version" in microcopy? I lean "Pin" because it's lighter and familiar to devs.
morgan: +1 to "Pin". Let's standardize: verb = "Pin"; active label = "Pinned". Update the strings file.
lee: Accessibility nit on filter chips: they should be role="button" and respond to Enter/Space. Also add visually hidden text for counts, e.g. "3 active filters" using `span.sr-only`.
jordan: I'll open a small PR that updates aria attributes and the pin button state. Also propose changing the "fast" badge color to #006644 for better contrast — ok to use that token?
maria: go for it. Please add a design token (badge-performance-fast) and wire it to both light/dark tokens.
morgan: Action items: jordan -> PR for aria + badge color; anya -> update Figma with collapsed/overflow filter pattern and mobile condensed metrics; lee -> keyboard/tabbing spec and filter focus implementation notes; sam -> consolidate microcopy decisions and update i18n keys. We'll review changes in mock review tomorrow at 10:00am PT. :thumbsup:
